title: CoreWeave boosts 2026 spending plan, beats quarterly estimates on AI demand surge
summary: CoreWeave lifted its annual capital spending forecast on Tuesday after beating second-quarter estimates, encouraged by a surge in demand for ‌its AI cloud computing services, sending the company's shares more than 14% ‌higher in extended trading.  CoreWeave now expects full-year capital expenditure to be between $35 billion and $39 billion, up from its previous expectations of $31 billion to $35 billion.  So-called neoclouds such as CoreWeave and peer ‌Nebius, which offer hardware and ⁠cloud capacity to other technology companies, have seen demand skyrocket as a result of relentless enterprise spending on AI.
